command.name: history.restore
command.summary: Restore a saved version, as the version history's Restore does: the document becomes that version, title and icon too.
command.guidance: Only when the user asks for it. Sub-pages keep their own history. No other version is deleted. history.undo cannot undo a restore: to go back, restore the result's previous version. A version that removes, unlocks or reshapes a database a person locked asks the person first; a no, or no way to ask, fails with APPROVAL_REQUIRED. Read the document again before your next write.
